intent: Customer asks the bank to split a returned tenancy deposit credit (£1,260.00) and send three new-payee payments to flatmates today.
summary: £1,260.00 credit is booked and available. Two blockers: Jack Elson's requested £375.00 conflicts with the agency statement and her own CSV note (£337.50), making the split £1,297.50 (£37.50 over the deposit); Emerald Creagh's CoP is no match (name held "E CREAGH-DOYLE"). Decision: send Salvatore Russell's £247.50 (CoP match, reconciles) for secure in-app confirmation now; ask the customer to confirm Jack's amount and to verify Emerald's details directly with Emerald before any payment to her; reply with the figures, no same-day promise.

facts.claim: Credit of £1,260.00 from "OAKFIELD PM CLIENT A/C" ref "DEP RETURN 7 ISFIELD RD" was booked to the customer's personal current account on 22 Sep 10:05; prior balance £412.30.
Customer requests payments of Salvatore £247.50, Jack £375.00, Emerald £337.50, keeping £337.50 herself; she states all tenants agreed deductions in writing and asks for same-day sending.

Agency statement shows deposit £1,800.00, deductions £540.00 (garden £300 shared, plumbing £90 S. Russell only, cleaning £150 shared), £1,260.00 returned, and per-tenant shares Yagisawa £337.50, Russell £247.50, Elson £337.50, Creagh £337.50, which sum to £1,260.00.

Customer's requested amounts sum to £1,297.50 (£960.00 to send plus £337.50 kept), £37.50 more than the £1,260.00 received; the discrepancy is Jack Elson at £375.00 versus £337.50, and the CSV note for Jack ("450 - 75 - 37.50") itself computes to £337.50.

CoP: Salvatore Russell (SYN-SC-07-2 / SYN-ACCT-07-1) match; Jack Elson (SYN-SC-07-3 / SYN-ACCT-07-3) match; Emerald Creagh (SYN-SC-07-1 / SYN-ACCT-07-2) no match, reason ANNM, name held at bank "E CREAGH-DOYLE".

The request is made in the authenticated in-app personal banking chat linked to the customer's account record; no mandate from the flatmates is needed because the payments are from the customer's own account on her instruction.
The servicing agent has told the customer the amounts will be checked against what came in; no payment has been set up or sent.

missing: Customer's confirmation of Jack Elson's amount: £337.50 (agency statement and her own CSV note) or £375.00 (her request).

Customer's confirmation, obtained directly from Emerald Creagh, that sort code SYN-SC-07-1 / account SYN-ACCT-07-2 is Emerald's account held in the name E Creagh-Doyle, and her explicit decision whether to proceed despite the CoP no-match.
Customer's secure in-app confirmation of the new payee and £247.50 payment to Salvatore Russell.

steps.instruction: Send to the customer's secure in-app confirmation: new payee Salvatore Russell, sort code SYN-SC-07-2, account SYN-ACCT-07-1 (CoP match), Faster Payment £247.50 from her personal current account, reference 'Deposit 7 Isfield Rd'. Payment is not released until she confirms in the app.

rationale.explanation: This payee is CoP matched and the £247.50 reconciles exactly with the agency statement and the customer's CSV, so it can proceed on her secure confirmation without waiting for the other two to be resolved.
rationale.criterion: Identify the exact transaction by reference, amount and parties; a clean, reconciled instruction from an authenticated customer on her own account may proceed to secure confirmation.

steps.instruction: Ask the customer: 'Your request lists Jack Elson at £375.00, but the agency statement shows his share as £337.50 and your own note for him (450 − 75 − 37.50) also comes to £337.50. With £375.00 the four shares total £1,297.50, £37.50 more than the £1,260.00 returned. Please confirm which amount you want to send Jack: £337.50 or £375.00.'

rationale.explanation: The customer's figure for Jack is internally inconsistent with her own note and the agency document, and over-allocates the deposit by £37.50; the bank must not guess or alter the amount.
rationale.criterion: Name an unresolved conflict and request the specific missing fact rather than guessing; do not change an instructed amount unilaterally.

steps.instruction: Ask the customer: 'Confirmation of Payee could not match the name "Emerald Creagh" to sort code SYN-SC-07-1 / account SYN-ACCT-07-2 — the bank holding that account has the name as "E CREAGH-DOYLE". Please check directly with Emerald (by a contact method you already use with her, not from the details you were sent) that this is her account and that name. Once you have, tell us whether you want to go ahead with the £337.50 to those details. If the details are wrong, a payment may not be recoverable.'

rationale.explanation: A CoP no-match (ANNM) means the payee name does not match the account; the mismatch may be a hyphenated surname but the bank cannot assume that, so the customer must verify with the payee and explicitly decide before any payment is set up.
rationale.criterion: Hold the risky action and obtain the customer's informed confirmation when payee verification fails; never assume a name mismatch is benign.

steps.instruction: Reply in the in-app chat: 'Thanks — the £1,260.00 from Oakfield PM reached your account on 22 September and is available. I've checked your split against the agency statement. Two things before I can send everything: (1) Jack's amount — your request says £375.00 but the agency statement and your own note give £337.50; at £375.00 the four shares come to £1,297.50, £37.50 more than was returned. Please confirm which you want. (2) Emerald — our name check couldn't match "Emerald Creagh" to the account details; that bank holds the name as "E CREAGH-DOYLE". Please check directly with Emerald that these are her details, then let me know if you want to go ahead; if details are wrong the money may not be recoverable. Salvatore's £247.50 matched correctly and I'm sending it to you now to confirm securely in the app — it isn't sent until you confirm it. Once you confirm Jack's amount and Emerald's details, I'll set those up the same way. I can't promise they will arrive today, but I'll move as quickly as possible. I'm not able to comment on the deductions themselves — these payments go on your instruction from your account.'

rationale.explanation: Gives the customer the booked credit status, the exact reconciliation discrepancy, the CoP warning and what remains pending, without claiming any payment has been sent or promising same-day arrival.
rationale.criterion: State only the stage the record proves (credit booked; payments not sent) and do not promise arrival times absent an applicable commitment.

must_state: £1,260.00 from Oakfield PM was credited to the account on 22 Sep and is available.

The agency statement's shares (Salvatore £247.50, Jack £337.50, Emerald £337.50, Miya £337.50) total £1,260.00; her request has Jack at £375.00, making the total £1,297.50, £37.50 more than was returned, and her own note for Jack works out to £337.50 — she needs to confirm which figure she wants.

Confirmation of Payee could not match "Emerald Creagh" to the account given; the bank holding it has the name as "E CREAGH-DOYLE". She should check directly with Emerald that these details are hers before sending; a payment sent to wrong details may not be recoverable.
Salvatore's £247.50 payment (CoP matched) is being sent to her for secure confirmation in the app and is not sent until she confirms it.
Payments to Jack and Emerald will be set up once she confirms the two points above; the bank cannot promise same-day arrival.
must_not: Do not state that any payment has been sent, scheduled or will arrive today.
Do not send the Emerald Creagh payment on the current CoP no-match result without the customer's explicit confirmation after checking with Emerald.
Do not send Jack Elson's payment at £375.00 without the customer confirming that amount despite the discrepancy.
Do not adjudicate or opine on whether the deposit deductions or the split between flatmates are fair or correct; the bank acts only on the customer's instruction from her own account.
Do not ask for PINs, passwords or one-time codes in chat.
Do not change the customer's instructed amounts unilaterally.
